name: sme-contiguous-panels-unroll4
hypothesis: Pack A and B into contiguous 2VL-wide panels, then unroll the product loop by four. This replaces the baseline's n-float load strides with sequential loads and removes tail predicates from the product loop. Repeated panel use can offset the added B packing cost at n=512. This candidate is untested; repeated measurements must establish whether it exceeds 1780 GFLOP/s.
